name: sidedash
description: Personal macOS menubar dashboard for running side-project CLI tools

scripts.package: electron-vite build && electron-packager . sidedash --platform=darwin --out=dist --overwrite --prune --icon=build/icon.icns --ignore="^/src($|/)" --ignore="^/docs($|/)" --ignore="^/build($|/)" --ignore="^/\.superpowers($|/)" --ignore="^/\.claude($|/)" --ignore="^/tsconfig.*\.json$" --ignore="^/electron\.vite\.config\.ts$" && find dist -exec touch {} +
